text:
samir: Quick heads-up — ran a dry-run failing over a BYOK customer KMS when the HSM proxy returned a 502. During the sim, operators were blocked from rewrapping keys. Need an RBAC tweak + audit logging changes before we run a full drill.

jules: can you paste the error/logs? was this in staging or prod?

samir: staging only. log excerpt:
```
2026-03-19T14:02:11Z proxy.hsm -> 502 Bad Gateway
2026-03-19T14:02:11Z rewrap-service: error rewrap request_id=req_0x9f3a customer_key=cust_12345 op=rewrap actor=ops:jules reason="proxy unreachable"
```
and the client-side error:
```
{"error":"rewrap failed","code":"HSM_PROXY_UNAVAILABLE","detail":"operator lacks permission: kms:rewrap"}
```

katie: ok. two quick asks:
1) RBAC: add kms:rewrap to the hsm-operator role but scoped to resource arn:redwood:kms::cust_*/rewrap and gated behind dual-operator for production tenants. example policy snippet:
```
# pseudo-iam
allow: action: ["kms:rewrap"]
principal: role:hsm-operator
resource: arn:redwood:kms:::customer/*/key/*/rewrap
conditions: { approval: { type: "dual-operator", required: 2 } }
```
2) Audit: ensure every rewrap has request_id, operator_session_id, and the proxy response logged to syslog with retention 7y for enterprise customers (legal asked for 7 yrs).

mike: re: dual-operator — regulatory note: for EU banking tenants, we need explicit two-person approval enforced by an external approval workflow (not just an IAM condition). That means our JIT escalate flow needs an A/B witness check that cannot be bypassed by a single bearer token.

tanvi: also add immutable evidence to the audit record: hash of the operator approval blob + timestamp + request_id. That way rewraps are provable in audits. retention: 7y for EU, 2y for others.

jules: I can re-run the sim. What telemetry should I capture? full proxy logs + runtime stacktrace + operator session metadata?

katie: yes, plus a curl we can use to tag requests for easy correlation:
```
curl -H "X-Request-ID: test-rewrap-$(date +%s)" -H "X-Operator-Session: sess_abc123" -X POST https://staging-proxy.redwood.internal/rewrap ...
```

samir: cool. i'll schedule a 30-min window tomorrow 16:00 PT for the sim. @katie @mike @tanvi please join. i'll enable extra verbose logging and collect syslog + s3 dump of audit blobs. if we hit the permission block again, we can test two approaches: (A) temporary role grant via JIT with approval webhook, (B) fallback to regional software-only rewrap path (lower assurance) and trigger an incident.

mike: +1 on testing both. tagging compliance to confirm fallback acceptability: @legal-compliance (cc)

incident-bot: Scheduled simulation 'kms-rewrap-failure-mode' by samir for 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z — reminders set.

jules: i'll run the test and post the correlated logs here. :thumbsup:

samir: thanks all. if we get clean run then we update runbook and roll to prod canary with dual-operator enforced. otherwise we'll draft an emergency mitigation plan.
